frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015), 69.34″ = 3.20 kpc: 438 pc. For young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: HII region candidates of M74 that Rousseau-Nepton et al. (2018) found with the SITELLE imaging spectrometer over the whole disc: one dot per region at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way HII layer's pink (hou-han-hii), as M31's and M33's HII regions use. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
